name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-personalized-tarot-card-prompt
title: My Personal Tarot Card
shortDescription: Create a photo-inspired vintage tarot-style card and a separate symbolic reading reflecting your year, strengths, and personal themes.
longDescription: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot to create a personalized 2026 tarot-style card from a reference photo and available context. The prompt invents an archetype, requests a vintage illustrated card with meaningful personal symbols, and provides a separate reading covering strengths, a blind spot, a symbolic new-year prophecy, hidden meanings, and a closing message. Intended for creative reflection and entertainment, not factual assessment or prediction.
